scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format
scripts.proto: pnpm exec pbts -i website/src/assets/proto/proto.proto -o lib/src/generated/proto.ts && echo 'You will have to manually clean up the file as it may have errors'
scripts.helpers: jiti scripts/generate-helpers.ts && pnpm exec prettier --write lib/src/generated/helpers.ts
scripts.nodes: jiti scripts/generate-node-helpers.ts && pnpm exec prettier --write lib/src/generated/nodes.ts
